text: I had an appointment to have my braces removed via LINE on Sunday, but the clinic notified me via WhatsApp, which I don't use, resulting in my appointment being canceled. This careless management has wasted a lot of my time. The appointment scheduling system needs improvement. P.S. I saw a reply saying they tried to contact me through every channel. Why didn't they contact me through the first channel used to schedule the appointment? My appointment was at 1:00 PM, but I arrived at the clinic between 1:01 PM and 1:05 PM. The staff said I had rescheduled several times, but I had only scheduled one appointment beforehand. At that time, I mentioned that if I couldn't come as scheduled, a new appointment would be arranged. This was the second rescheduling attempt. The staff claimed I was late, even though I arrived around 1:01 PM - 1:05 PM. Furthermore, the appointment scheduling system needs improvement. I contacted them via LINE, but they responded via WhatsApp instead. Their claim of trying multiple channels is untrue; the initial appointment was via LINE. They said there are multiple staff members and they don't know who scheduled the appointment. This highlights a serious issue with the back-end system for managing patient appointments. I was trying to convey that the appointment was cancelled because I had cancelled appointments with the clinic multiple times. The second time, I arrived on time, but the staff cancelled the appointment via WhatsApp, which wasn't enabled, so I wasn't aware of the cancellation. The point I want to make is about the appointment management system. There's a lack of internal communication among the staff, leading to errors. The original clinic, if there's no answer, would send a confirmation message through the initial contact method to confirm the appointment. This made me feel that the clinic's appointment management system is inefficient. The staff also tried to blame me, saying that I had rescheduled multiple times, which is why the clinic cancelled it. Even though the staff asked if I wanted to wait, they didn't specify how long, saying, "You didn't ask how long," and "We didn't say we wouldn't serve you." This was a very inappropriate response. They also claimed that I was late, which I countered, but only between 13:01 and 13:05. The staff insisted that was untrue, saying it was later than that. I was very displeased with this staff member's behavior. They said it was because I had rescheduled multiple times, even though I had only rescheduled once. Furthermore, before making the first appointment, I informed the staff member who had scheduled it that if I couldn't make it this time, I would reschedule. This happened more than once, totaling several times. However, there was only one time we actually rescheduled. The staff member I spoke with emphasized the rescheduling issue instead of addressing the back-end appointment management system that I was questioning.
